Hi Samir / Elena,

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. As discussed, next steps from our side on the security/compliance discovery:

- We need a short pile of IAM evidence to accelerate SOC 2 review and the security questionnaire. Specifically: SSO/SAML configuration (IDP metadata), SCIM provisioning support (endpoints or docs), RBAC model and admin controls (how admins are provisioned and emergency access processes).
- Please also confirm SOC 2 status (Type II or Type I), and whether you have any HIPAA/GDPR constraints we should be aware of for contract/legal review.

I've attached a short checklist to make this easy. If you can drop the SAML metadata and the vendor security questionnaire (we attached one for you to fill), that will let our security team start verification.

Attachments: redwood-iam-evidence-checklist.pdf (PDF, 180KB)

Suggested next steps / timeline:
1) You share IDP metadata and questionnaire by end of next week (2/19).
2) Our security lead (cc’d) will review and send any follow-ups.
3) Procurement and legal will lean on SOC 2 and FAQs to finalize terms — HubSpot deal ID DEAL-6742-VH will track progress.

If you prefer a dedicated call with our security team, happy to schedule — Aditya is copied and can join for the technical bits.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
